claim: *Modeling as a loop.* (a) Models produced after implementation: the linear design → implement → document-with-models sequence. (b) A problem drives a model; analysis yields a prediction and a design; those drive implementation and measurement; measurement refines the model, and the loop continues while the questions justify the cost.
topology: Linear after-the-fact documentation contrasted with model-analysis-prediction-implementation-measurement feedback.
bw_encoding: White ordinary nodes and groups; labels and boundaries carry roles without decorative tones.
redesign: Resolved inconsistent original SVG arrow near prediction/design to chapter-described causality: analysis yields prediction/design, which drives implementation. Grayscale refinement: After-the-fact document chain muted; live model emphasized; editorial arrow resolution retained.
questions: Original SVG arrow near prediction/design pointed upward from implementation; candidate follows chapter and SVG description. Confirm this editorial repair.
alt: Two panels. (a) Models after implementation: a linear sequence of design, implement, then document with models. (b) It can be a loop: a problem drives a model; analyzing the model yields a prediction and a design; those drive implementation and then measurement; measurement refines the model, and the loop continues while the questions justify the cost.
